name: Street Pizza
detailed_description:
Street Pizza is a chaotic action roguelike that puts you in the shoes of a pizza delivery boy determined to do his duty, even in the midst of a zombie apocalypse! Explore a devastated city, divided into 4 unique worlds (from a decaying old town to a dark sewer tunnel), each with hordes of mutant undead, deadly traps and a boss guarding the delivery route.

Fight, survive and evolve:

Defeat waves of enemies to collect resources and choose between random abilities after each stage (such as "Allied UFO", "Summon the moon" or even "Rocket Launcher") to adapt to the chaos.

Strategic management: Choose between speed, strength or defense to survive, but be careful: time is running out and the pizza needs to arrive hot!

Permanent death, continuous progression: each attempt unlocks improvements, abilities and new cards to make you stronger in the next battle.

In addition to the carnage, use the environment to your advantage: detonate fuel barrels, blow up cars and defeat zombies with your summons. But remember: the customer is always right... even if it's an angry zombie wanting your brain (and your pizza).

Get ready for a bloody delivery, full of dark humor, brutal challenges and the burning question:

"Do you have what it takes to be the Hero (and Delivery Man) of the Apocalypse?"

short_description: Street Pizza is a frantic action game where a pizza delivery guy battles zombie hordes to fulfill orders in an apocalyptic world. Wield improvised weapons, dodge hazards, and race against time to avoid becoming zombie food… and keep the pizza piping hot!

English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support
